measurement.metric: Completed MapLibre render callbacks/s and full adjacent timestamp tails; not monitor-presented FPS or input-to-photon latency.

measurement.coldMeaning: Fresh Chrome context and first traversal. OS/server/driver/proxy caches were not cleared.

findings: Cold pan106.59 callbacks/s, p95 17.0ms, max122.6ms; prior combined01 max993.4ms. Cold zoom98.38/s, p95 22.6ms, max104.4ms; prior max636.1ms. No interval>250ms in any moving window.
Warm return90.72/s, p95 37.3ms, max121.1ms;19 intervals>50ms and2>100ms. Rotation111.59/s max118.0ms; near pan118.11/s max25.9ms; zoom-out114.98/s max43.9ms.

Actual zoom targets18.500000062092244 and15.703057324223563 reached. Pause0completed render callbacks/2207.8ms. Applied Worker motion lag near0.15simseconds, no endpoint underflow; final pause0.1708simseconds. Motion source post maximum16.6ms, roundtrip maximum330.6ms.
Cold mouse-protocol maximum lateness192.4ms; warm-return accumulated lateness639.5ms; near pan15.1ms. This is remaining input backpressure evidence, not measured input-to-photon latency.

Top-level Worker transport, shader readiness, environment, ownership, no-close-aggregate, memory and actor checks passed. The six-owner retrospective check finds error_retained landuse memory and building-contact grid fallbacks at wide views. The original generic numeric verdict is therefore narrower than full ground success.

Landuse can start with no synthesized ground, then retain the previous near coverage when wide preparation exceeds its bound. Contact lighting similarly retains a small prior coverage. Roads remain partial at bounded marking limits. These are explicit source-rendering fallbacks; scientific records and map geometry are unchanged.

All six PNGs were opened. Building blocks remain visibly present and nearby people are recognizable models; the roof normal fix reduces stripe contrast without suppressing shadows. Smooth crowns, regular facade cadence and plain broad native ground remain content limitations. No literal SimCity equivalence claim.

The owner requested publication with the remaining bugs deferred; no additional traffic run or browser acceptance was executed afterward.
